hook: Why AI increasingly wants to run on your laptop.

beats.say: Pete Warden, co-creator of Moonshine Voice and a longtime deep learning engineer, explains why AI wants to run locally rather than in the cloud.
He covers the fast progress of open-weight models, and what it takes to run AI on laptops and in browsers. Apple's M5 Studio can have 256 gigabytes of memory.
Plus how low-latency speech models could make voice a natural interface, and hardware that could challenge GPUs.
